thread:
mel: Heads-up — customer hit 413s when sending mixed-dim embeddings. Preflight returned 200 but runtime rejected.

ryan: ugh. do we have example payload?

mel: small batch, two vectors 1024 and rest 512. curl in INC-4998.

dina: if client doesn't send dim hint our estimator uses bytes only. mixed dims can blow per-shard payload.

omar: short fixes: change 413 body to actionable text + emit telemetry event 'embed.ingress.oversize' with tags {dims_hint, max_dim, num_vectors}.

mel: console idea: show "Mixed dims detected" in request inspector with quick actions: sample curl to set X-Vector-Dim, link to SDK upgrade, and an "enable auto-split for tenant" toggle (if allowed).

dryan: for runtime auto-split it's risky perf-wise. propose gated rollout: feature flag -> 0.5% tenants -> 5% -> 100% with KPIs (413 rate, p95 latency, CPU). Add node-level kill-switch.

dina: also add preflight 422 response when mixed dims are detected so clients get structured guidance: {"code":"mixed_dims","suggestions":[...]}

platform-bot: created PERF-5980 assigned to eng-platform: "embeds: mixed-dim preflight + console hints + telemetry".

omar: ok owners: I'll PR telemetry + 413 body. dina you take 422 preflight. mel/ryan work console mock. We'll coordinate rollout and add runbook.

mel: thanks, will follow up with RFC and timeline. :rocket:
